options.name: core
options.description: The UI artifact to unpack and the trust it is verified against.

settings.name: registryBase
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_REGISTRY_BASE: Base URL of the registry the artifact is pulled from.

settings.name: signatureTag
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_SIG_TAG: The tag of the artifact signature.

settings.name: manifestDigest
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_MANIFEST_DIGEST: The manifest digest the artifact must have.

settings.name: appName
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_APP_NAME: The application the UI belongs to.

settings.name: trustRootRef
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_TRUST_ROOT_REF: The trust root the signature must chain to.

settings.name: dataDir
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_DATA_DIR: Folder the UI is unpacked into.

settings.name: trustDir
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_UI_TRUST_DIR: Folder of the trusted public keys.
